questions.q: Which Fantastic Four member is Sue's younger brother?
questions.why: Johnny is Sue's hot-headed younger brother, the Human Torch.

questions.q: Besides turning invisible, what is Sue best known for projecting?
questions.why: Her core powers are invisibility and invisible force fields.

questions.q: Which actress played Sue Storm in the 2005 Fantastic Four film?
questions.why: Jessica Alba played Sue in the 2005 film.

questions.q: Which two children do Sue Storm and Mister Fantastic have?
questions.why: Sue and Reed's children are Franklin and Valeria Richards.
Stan Lee and Jack Kirby created her in Fantastic Four #1.

questions.q: Sue's power was inspired by which 1933 film?
questions.why: Stan Lee was inspired by The Invisible Man (1933).

questions.q: After a stillbirth, which villain manipulated Sue into becoming Malice?
questions.why: Psycho-Man manipulated Sue into becoming Malice.

questions.q: Which sea-king was attracted to Sue, forming a love triangle with Reed?
questions.why: Sue was attracted to Namor, forming Marvel's first love triangle.

questions.q: Sue Storm is described as Marvel's first female superhero of which comics age?
questions.why: She is called the first female superhero Marvel published in the Silver Age.

questions.q: In which issue does Sue change her codename to Invisible Woman?
questions.why: She changed her codename to Invisible Woman in Fantastic Four #284.
